## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue when useful.

## Validation

List focused and applicable repository/browser/backend/release commands that actually finished, with
their results. Distinguish automated checks from manual reader, physical-device and hosted
observations. State any check not performed and why.

## Data and compatibility

Describe schema/format changes, migration or rollback compatibility, owner/sync effects, and
recovery behavior when relevant. If unchanged, say so briefly.

## Review notes

Include relevant docs/decision updates, accessibility observations and remaining limitations. Use
only synthetic evidence. Do not include credentials, real planning content, raw exports or full
environment/Supabase status output.
